kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتمرجل (form IIq)
# نَتَمَرْجَلُ (natamarjalu) /na.ta.mar.d͡ʒa.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَمَرْجَلَ (tamarjala)
# نَتَمَرْجَلَ (natamarjala) /na.ta.mar.d͡ʒa.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَمَرْجَلَ (tamarjala)
# نَتَمَرْجَلْ (natamarjal) /na.ta.mar.d͡ʒal/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَمَرْجَلَ (tamarjala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
